units: <cite ref="Ketubot 72a:19">Keth. 72ᵃ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 5:18">Num. V, 18</cite>) <he>אזהרה … שלא יצאו בפ׳ ראש</he> this implies a warning for the daughters of Israel not to go out bareheaded. Ib.ᵇ <he>אין בו משום פ׳ ראש</he> is does not come under the category of bareheadedness.
<cite ref="Berakhot 62a:10-14">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>כל זמן … את פֵּרוּעוֹ</he> so that his neighbor may not see him uncover himself.
